name: Evidence foundation
exit_gate: SPIKE-001 through SPIKE-010 have owners, harnesses, and pass/fail gates; WP-001 complete
deliverables: Research baseline; corpus protocol; spike reports; repository/CI baseline

name: Operational foundations
entry_criteria: Blocking spikes for selected work packages pass
exit_gate: CLI, config, filesystem identity, metadata/codecs, model/runtime contracts work in diagnostic mode
deliverables: doctor/inspect alpha; capability matrix; runtime/model/metadata prototypes

name: Read-only orientation planner
exit_gate: Scan-only workflow produces immutable, explainable plans and meets pilot precision gate
deliverables: orientation engine; calibration; SQLite jobs; scan command

name: Safe-copy processing
entry_criteria: Planner stable and transform/recovery spikes passed
exit_gate: End-to-end safe-copy scan/apply/verify resumes safely and passes JPEG/metadata gates
deliverables: transform; verify; bounded executor; safe-copy beta

name: Professional operations
exit_gate: Review, in-place backup/undo, job integrity, reporting, and support diagnostics pass fault tests
deliverables: review workflow; guarded in-place; undo; operational CLI

name: Quality and hardening
exit_gate: ML, security, privacy, performance, soak, compatibility, and recovery release thresholds pass
deliverables: evaluation report; threat review; benchmark report; compatibility matrix

name: Distribution candidate
exit_gate: Signed portable and installer candidates pass clean-VM/offline install, update, rollback, and SBOM checks
deliverables: signed artifacts; installer; SBOM; checksums; provenance

name: Release candidate
exit_gate: All Must requirements and release ACs traced to passing evidence; no unaccepted critical risk
deliverables: RC; release notes; support runbook; traceability evidence pack
